title: Effect 'Deal 4 to a unit at a battlefield' never happens
expected: Sky Cruiser (ven-060-166) has no hand-authored abilities in ven.json; enrichCard re-parses rulesText at runtime into an activated ability with cost `{discard: {amount: 1, cardType: "gear"}, energy: 1, exhaust: true}` (verified by dumping getCardRegistry().get("ven-060-166")). The discard cost is an OBJECT, but activate-ability.ts only handles a numeric discard cost: condition (line 715-716) and enumerator (line 1068-1071) do `cost.discard as number; if (discardCost && discardCost > 0)` — `{...} > 0` is false, so no hand check runs and no `discardId` is enumerated/required. The reducer then pays energy (line 1272 deductAbilityCost) and sets exhausted (line 1290-1291) BEFORE reaching line 1324-1327: `if (cost.discard) { if (!discardId) { return; } }` — the object is truthy, discardId is undefined, so the reducer returns early after costs are taken and before addToChain (line 1429). Result: energy -1, host exhausted, no chain item, no pendingChoice, no damage — exactly the observed behavior.
observed: After activateAbility {targets:[Phantom]}: energy -1 and Sky Cruiser exhausted (costs taken) but no chain item was created, no pendingChoice, and Phantom meta.damage stayed 0 (twice). Control: Hextech Ray on the same Phantom correctly set damage=3, so damage tracking works — the ability's effect is simply dropped
